Vote strata: bins of the allele votes per class x depth stratum

Source: R/caller.R
vote_bins.Rd

Under the null the allelic LLR of a fixed gain fraction f is linear in nA: its mean is about n_hap x 0.5 log(4 f (1 - f)) and its spread grows with sqrt(n_hap), so one null quantile per class is set by the vote-rich regions (large chromosomes) and is too loose for vote-poor ones (small chromosomes such as chr21 carry several times fewer votes than chr1). Thresholds keyed on class x stratum x hstratum (bins of n_hap) pool regions with similar vote counts instead of estimating one threshold per region.

Usage

vote_bins(
  d,
  n_bins = params$vote_bins,
  min_null = params$min_null_rows,
  null = NULL,
  params = caller_defaults()
)

Arguments

d

rows with class, stratum, n_hap and a null definition (budget_thresholds())

n_bins

maximal bins per class x stratum (params$vote_bins)

min_null

minimal null rows per bin (params$min_null_rows)

null

optional logical null flag per row

params

caller_defaults()

Value

data.table class, stratum, hstratum, lo, hi, n_null (null rows with votes in the class x stratum)

Details

Per class x stratum, the null rows with votes (n_hap > 0) are cut at their type-7 quantiles into k = max(1, min(n_bins, floor(n / min_null))) bins of (nearly) equal size, so a bin keeps min_null null rows. Bin i covers lo < n_hap <= hi. assign_hstratum() labels rows h1..hk, none (no votes) or all (a class x stratum without bins).
